items.text: Ravens finalizing trade for Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett (deal expected weekend); Fagnano starts TNF, Brissett likely Week 10+ starter vs LAC.
items.why: BAL QB depth decimated by Jackson/Huntley/Fagnano ankle; ARI benched Brissett for Minshew.
items.implication: Stabilizes BAL offense ROS; more dropbacks, fewer scrambles than Lamar.
items.opportunity: Higher pass volume (Brissett 47% of starts 35+ attempts vs Lamar 15%) for Flowers/Andrews/Henry.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) 3x DNP, listed Questionable and game-time decision for TNF vs Ravens; Coen says feels better but no practice Wednesday.
items.why: Ankle/foot; left briefly Week 8 but returned for big game; short week no practice.
items.implication: If OUT/INACTIVE, Chris Rodriguez elevates to lead role; check inactives pre-TNF.
items.opportunity: Full carry/target share to Rodriguez if Tuten sits or limited; reverse if unexpectedly ACTIVE.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is out indefinitely with a right thumb injury requiring surgery and is expected to land on IR; he will miss Thursday vs JAX and beyond.
items.why: Thumb injury on first snap Week 8; surgery needed per Schefter/Hensley.
items.implication: Ravens QB chaos; Fagnano starts TNF; Brissett incoming for Week 10+; Flowers/Henry/Andrews volume shifts under pocket passer.
items.opportunity: Increased pass volume potential for Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, Derrick Henry under Brissett/Fagnano vs Lamar scramble style.

items.text: Tests confirm Ravens QB Tyler Huntley suffered season-ending turf toe; out for year, surgery expected. Joe Fagnano starts Thursday vs Jaguars.
items.why: Turf toe confirmed via tests after Week 8 injury; similar to prior Burrow case per Rapoport.
items.implication: Ravens fully without top-2 QBs; accelerates Brissett trade; Fagnano one-game bridge.
items.opportunity: Short-term Fagnano/Brissett pass volume; Henry/Flowers remain viable but efficiency drop expected.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love headed to IR with high-ankle sprain (new injury portion); out 4-5 weeks. First-round pick previously dealing with different ankle issue.
items.why: High-ankle sprain suffered in win over Cowboys; confirmed by sources/LaFleur.
items.implication: ARI backfield opens; handcuff/backup elevation for remaining weeks.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps to next ARI RBs; monitor depth chart for goal-line/third-down roles.

items.text: Bull case for Ravens pass game under Brissett: less efficiency offset by more volume. Lamar 35+ att only 15% of starts; Brissett 47%. Worse QB than Lamar creates more passes and fewer scrambles.
items.why: Career start data on pass attempts; Brissett pocket style vs Lamar dual-threat.
items.implication: Flowers/Andrews target upside rises ROS despite lower QB talent; Henry receiving work possible.
items.opportunity: Route/target volume expansion for BAL pass-catchers; monitor red-zone/third-down shares under new QB.

items.text: Levitan/Silva on Seattle backfield with Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returns: 'gonna be like Charbonnet/Walker expect with worse versions of the players' — committee expected.
items.why: Returns create split; video/analysis from ETR pod.
items.implication: Neither SEA RB full every-down; fade standalone starts, prefer handcuff pairs.
items.opportunity: Split carries/snaps/third-down; no clear lead back lock.

items.text: Jets WR Garrett Wilson placed in concussion protocol (day-to-day) after helmet hit late in Week 8; Week 9 status vs Chiefs in doubt, needs clearance by Saturday.
items.why: Helmet-to-helmet Week 8; symptoms Monday, protocol Wednesday per Glenn.
items.implication: If OUT, targets to Adonai Mitchell/others; Wilson still WR2 if clears.
items.opportunity: Secondary Jets WRs route/target spike if Wilson inactive.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) officially OUT for Week 9 vs Chargers; remains week-to-week after missing prior games + bye, though making progress.
items.why: Groin from Week 5; DNP Wednesday; Ryans confirms another miss.
items.implication: Woody Marks continues as lead RB2 vs soft LAC defense.
items.opportunity: Marks snaps/carries/red-zone locked in; Montgomery return target Week 10+.

items.text: ETR Week 9 flags: AJ Brown misses another game due to lingering knee/ankle issue; Lamar IR-likely and JT saga also highlighted in Silva/Levitan team-by-team.
items.why: Lingering knee issue per ETR pod/notes; multiple misses.
items.implication: NE pass-catchers elevate; monitor depth for targets/red-zone.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for remaining NE WRs/TEs.

items.text: Rams opening practice window for TE Terrance Ferguson. In last full game (Puka out): 70% routes on dropbacks, 29% target share, 42% slot/wide alignment.
items.why: Prior high route/target rates when healthy and Puka limited; McVay comments.
items.implication: Potential TE1 upside if role sticks; monitor snaps vs Kittle-like usage.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone if elevated; Puka healthy may compress.

items.text: Thorman Week 9 Snaps & Pace via ETR: DAL@IND up in pace; HOU@LAC slow slog. Other slate notes for opportunity modeling.
items.why: Historical/team pace data for projected plays.
items.implication: Higher play volume DAL/IND skill players; lower HOU/LAC.

items.text: Matthew Berry keeping it open on Ladd McConkey this week as a WR3 (not higher); reacts to foot injury practice (LP-DNP-LP) and cracked rib history.
items.why: Pregame/Happy Hour; volume intact if active despite limited practice.
items.implication: Flex/WR3 viable if clears; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if full go; LAC pass game reliance.

items.text: Jerry Jones said George Pickens needs the ball more; Berry: does not really change fantasy outlook (neutral). Even routes noted with Lamb/Flournoy.
items.why: Coach comment vs actual even route shares (Levitan data: Lamb 29, Flournoy 26, Pickens 25 on 38 dropbacks).
items.implication: No major upgrade; DAL WR committee continues; Pickens WR3/flex range.
items.opportunity: Monitor actual targets vs rhetoric; 2-TE sets compress WR snaps.
items.conflict: Coach wants more ball but usage data even/split.
